rationale: The safe-host baseline is robust_weekly_drift because it is the only executed and hindcast candidate and therefore has the lowest available historical hindcast sRMSE, with sMAE as tie-breaker. Documents doc_3831 and doc_3833 directly challenge its stable-weekday-offset assumption by reporting no identifiable weekly rhythm and recommending a long-term-mean forecast. However, no executed nonseasonal or evidence-adjusted candidate is available, so the contradictory evidence cannot justify selecting a nonexistent trajectory or modifying the supplied forecast. The stock-out evidence also cannot be applied because there is no executed future-adjusted candidate and verified_impacts is empty. The safe host choice is therefore retained.
